gaps.sentence: You should always ___ a contract before signing it.
gaps.explanation: 'Read through' = read from beginning to end carefully.

gaps.sentence: The old lamp turned ___ to be worth thousands.
gaps.explanation: turn out to be = prove to be in the end.

gaps.sentence: The match was ___ because of the storm.
gaps.explanation: call off = cancel; call up = phone/summon; call for = demand.

gaps.sentence: The medicine may make you feel ___ .
The hotel ___ breakfast until eleven at weekends.
gaps.explanation: 'Serve breakfast' = provide it to guests; the other options don't take this pattern.

gaps.sentence: The shortage of houses has ___ prices up.
gaps.explanation: 'Push prices up' = cause them to rise; 'pull/drag' would suggest downwards or physical movement.

gaps.sentence: I'd rather stay at home than ___ shopping with you.
gaps.explanation: 'would rather do A than do B' — both verbs bare infinitive.

gaps.sentence: The flight was ___ to be full, so we booked early.
gaps.explanation: 'Be bound to do' = certain to do.
